title: The Rev. Charles Moor
dates: (b.1857)
---

second son of the Rev.

John Frewen Moor, jr.

He was curate of Grimsby for four years, then (1889) Vicar of Barton on Humber; he married (1889) Constance Mary Moon, and retired in 1901 to Westgate on sea; he had several children. [1861 census; Erminois]
